about: G9 purpose check golden set. All requests are made up for the test. expected: block = the product's purpose is harmful (weapons, war/violence, sexual, illegal), pass = a legitimate product even if it uses a trap word (칼·전쟁·성인·폭탄). B13~B16 are border cases the user decided to let through (2026-11-18): war games, sword/knife-making workshops, survival game fields.
